There it builds a Werkzeug `Rule` via `self.url_rule_class(rule, methods=methods, **options)` (line 650) and registers it into `self.url_map` (a `werkzeug.routing.Map` instance created at app init, line 402) via `self.url_map.add(rule_obj)` (line 653) — this `url_map` is where all registered URL rules end up and is later used for request dispatch and `flask routes` CLI output.
